exposure: Trial of labor after Cesarean delivery (TOLAC) in twin pregnancies
outcome: combined adverse outcome (uterine rupture, Apgar < 7 at 5 min, and umbilical cord pH < 7.1)
cohort: Women with a twin gestation and one previous Cesarean delivery
finding: This study found that women with twin pregnancies undergoing TOLAC are less likely to have a successful spontaneous vaginal delivery and have a higher risk of uterine rupture, maternal complications, and combined adverse perinatal outcomes compared to women with singleton pregnancies undergoing TOLAC.
